scope: Offline frozen reconstruction of six retained actual preload-peak states, without solver integration or production changes.
selection: Closed pre-opening state, tau approximately .005/.02, theoretical-peak vicinity, native peak and end of retained peak window.
observations: Fixed native IDs and unchanged drained IDs; conditional surface pressure clamp only for saved time strictly after opening.
Original raw stress, pore and load force split, artificial viscosity and kinematic damping at saved geometry.
Raw pair-work identities and corrected-derivative work mismatch, not a complete finite-deformation energy balance.
Density compared with conditional inverse-deformation geometry and elastic stress trace, not an independent exact density solution.
Within-initial-shell angular pressure variation and transverse motion, kept distinct from radial theory error.
numeric_scope: Native states and rounded production scalar constants, but double geometry and summation. No bitwise GPU kernel or previous-stage load replay claim.
sampling_scope: Only six instantaneous samples. Power lines are not integrated dissipation or proof about unsaved transients.
